description: E2: the Cinder Titan's crust and horns, quenched in the Ashbeck and beaten at Last Hearth's forge once he has fallen - a slag-crowned helm, quenched pauldrons, a coat of slag scales, ember vambraces, ash-walker greaves and the Heart-coal. It keeps the fire off the giant who wears it: heat takes less hold of him, and the water cools him faster.

bonuses.name: Quenched
bonuses.text: Heat takes 25% less hold of you

bonuses.name: The Forge-giant's Hide
bonuses.text: Heat takes a further 40% less hold of you: you walk his burning ground as he walked it
